_comment: Coverage ratchet baseline — total LINE coverage % per suite, MEASURED from a real CI-equivalent run. The coverage-ratchet script compares each run against these (NOISE_TOLERANCE_PP slack). vitest: informational signal (the vitest.config thresholds are the hard gate). rust: HARD-GATED (the rust ratchet call passes --gate; a drop beyond tolerance fails the cargo-coverage job, which is in validate-all's needs) and measured WORKSPACE-wide since #2817. Re-baseline on main with `--update` after a deliberate change. rust: every figure before #4643 was the app crate ALONE — `cargo llvm-cov report` without `--workspace` keeps only the root package, so the member crates' lines never reached the lcov and each extraction (c13e6d2, #2621 91.61→90.6, #4631 90.6→89.7, #4502 89.7→88.8) read as a phantom drop. #4643 adds `--workspace` to the report step; the value here is the first WORKSPACE-wide measurement, read off that PR's cargo-coverage run: 93.3% (92845 of 99517 lines).
